Rashi on Pesachim 88b:10:1.hebrew: שדעתן קלה - כדאמרן, שאין מקפידין אם גדי אם טלה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:10:1.english: Whose minds are easygoing - As we said [earlier], that they are not particular whether [it is] a kid or a lamb.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:10:2.hebrew: אנו לא נאכל - אם היה אחד ממנו שנשחטו עליו גדי וטלה, לא יאכל לא מן הראשון ולא מן השני, דכיון דקפיד, לא ידיע בהי ניחא ליה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:10:2.english: We would not eat - If it were one of us for whom a kid and a lamb were slaughtered, he may not eat from either the first or the second, for since he is particular, it is not known with which one he is pleased.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:11:1.hebrew: הלטאה - אחד משמנה שרצים המטמאין במגען, וביקשו לטמא, שהיו סבורים שמתה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:11:1.english: The lizard - One of the eight creeping creatures that impart ritual impurity through their contact, and they sought to declare [the meal] impure, for they thought that it had died.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:12:1.english: [Is] the slaughterhouse boiling or cold - That is to say, was it found in boiling [water] or in cold [water]?

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:12:2.english: And it quivered - And it twitched; and regarding ritual impurity, it is written, "when they are dead."

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:15:1.hebrew: בתקנתא דרביה - שאין לו תקנה אחרת, דהא לא מצי למימר: גדי שלי וטלה שלמים, ואם טלה אמר לי רבי, טלה שלי וגדי שלמים, כדמפרש לקמן (שממעט באכילתו, דקא אכיל לתרווייהו באותו הלילה משום ספק פסח, וחד מינייהו שלמים הוא):
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:15:1.english: With his master's remedy - For he has no other remedy, since he cannot say: "[If my master told me a kid,] the kid is mine [as a Paschal offering] and the lamb is a peace-offering, and if my master told me a lamb, the lamb is mine [as a Paschal offering] and the kid is a peace-offering," as [the Gemara] explains later (that he diminishes its [time of] eating, since he eats both of them on that night due to the uncertainty of [which is the] Paschal offering, while one of them is a peace-offering).

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:16:1.hebrew: לא שנו - דנפטרו מפסח שני, אלא ששכח רבו לאחר זריקת שני הדמים מה אמר לו. אבל בשעת זריקה עדיין הוא זכור, והיה אפשר לברר איזה של רב ואיזה של עבד, דכי איזדריק דם, לשם אכילה איזדריק, דהא ידיעי מנוייו דידיה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:16:1.english: They taught - that they are exempt from the second Pesach only when his master forgot what he had said to him after the sprinkling of the two bloods. Rather, at the time of sprinkling he still remembered, and it was possible to clarify which [animal] was the master's and which was the slave's, so that when the blood was sprinkled, it was sprinkled for the sake of eating, since its registrants were known.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:16:2.hebrew: [חייבין - דכי איזדריק לא לאכילת בשר איזדריק, דהא לא ידיעי מנוייו דידיה]:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:16:2.english: They are obligated - For when [the blood] was sprinkled, it was not sprinkled for eating the meat, since its registrants are not known.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:17:1.english: A wart - [This is] a disqualifying blemish.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:17:2.hebrew: באחד מהם - באחד העורות, ואין ידוע מאיזה פסח היה עור זה, ואותו הפסח פסול הוא:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:17:2.english: On one of them - On one of the hides, and it is not known from which Paschal lamb this hide was, and that Paschal lamb is invalid.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:17:3.hebrew: ופטורין מפסח שני - ולקמן פריך, והא איכא חד דלא נפק:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:17:3.english: And they are exempt from [the] second Pesach - And later [the Gemara] asks: But there is one who did not fulfill [his obligation]!

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:18:1.english: Abaye said: They only taught - that they are exempt [from the second Pesach].

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:19:1.hebrew: הוי חזי - ארבעה הכשירין לאכילה, הלכך הארבעה יצאו, והחמישי פטור, משום דלא ידיע מנו דלייתי, ולא אפשר לאיתויי חולין לעזרה, כדלקמיה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:19:1.english: [It] was fit - [That is,] the four [lambs] that are valid for eating. Therefore, the four [owners] fulfilled [their obligation], and the fifth is exempt because it is not known who it is that should bring [another offering], and it is not possible to bring unconsecrated [animals] into the Temple courtyard, as [explained] below.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:1:1.english: You have remedied [the situation of] his master - For he does not lose anything of what is due to him.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:1:2.english: And his own [situation] you have not remedied - What will become of him?

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:1:3.hebrew: לישא שפחה אינו יכול - דצד חירות אסור בה, דכתיב (דברים כ״ג:י״ח): ״לא יהיה קדש״ — לא יסב איתתא אמה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:1:3.english: He is not able to marry a maidservant - For the free side [of him] is forbidden to her, as it is written (Deuteronomy 23:18): “There shall be no kadesh” — [which Targum Onkelos renders:] “He shall not take a maidservant as a wife.”

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:20:1.hebrew: ה"ג אמר מר פטורין מלעשות פסח שני כו' - ואברייתא קאי:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:20:1.english: This is the reading: The Master said: [They] are exempt from observing [the] second Pesach, etc. - And it refers to the baraita.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:21:1.english: They are bringing unconsecrated [animals] into the [Temple] courtyard - [That is,] the four who have already fulfilled [their obligation].

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:22:1.english: Not for its registrants - For those who have already fulfilled [their obligation], their registration is nothing.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:3:1.hebrew: שחט גדי יאכל - רבו ממנו, ואע"ג דרגיל בטלה, דכיון דלא פריש ליה, עליה סמך:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:3:1.english: [If] he slaughtered a kid, he may eat - His master [may eat] from it, even though he is accustomed to a lamb; for since he did not specify to him, he relied upon him.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:3:2.english: He should eat from the first - And the second shall be burned.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:4:1.english: He forgot what his master said to him - That [his master] specified to him a kid or a lamb, and this [slave] forgot.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:4:2.hebrew: וטלה שלי - ובגמרא פריך: "מה שקנה עבד קנה רבו", ומנא ליה לדידיה:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:4:2.english: And the lamb is mine - And in the Gemara it asks: "Whatever a slave acquires, his master acquires," so from where does he [have an animal] of his own?

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:5:1.english: His master forgot what he said to him - And this one [the slave] had already slaughtered the two [animals].

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:5:2.hebrew: שניהם יצאו לבית השריפה - דלא ידיע הי דהאי והי דהאי, ואין פסח נאכל אלא למנויו:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:5:2.english: Both of them go out to the place of burning - For it is not known which belongs to this one and which belongs to that one, and a Pesach [offering] is eaten only by those registered for it.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:5:3.hebrew: ופטורין מפסח שני - דשחיטה וזריקה מעלייתא היא, חדא אהאי וחדא אדהאי, וקמי שמיא גליא:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:5:3.english: And they are exempt from the second Pesach - For [the] slaughter and sprinkling [of the blood] is valid, one for this one and one for that one, and before Heaven it is revealed.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:7:1.hebrew: והתניא אין נמנין על שני פסחים כאחד - לאכול בשעת אכילה מא' מהם שירצה, דאין ברירה, וכי בעי למיכל, דילמא בשעת שחיטה לא הוה דעתיה עליה, הלכך לא אכיל. וזה שהמנה את רבו על שני פסחים ורבו סמך עליו, היאך יאכל מן הראשון:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:7:1.english: Wasn't it taught: One may not be registered for two Paschal offerings at once - To eat at the time of eating from [whichever] one of them he wishes, for there is no retroactive designation [bereirah], and when he wants to eat, perhaps at the time of slaughter his mind was not on it; therefore, he may not eat [it]. And this [slave] who registered his master for two Paschal offerings and his master relied on him, how may he eat from the first one?

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:9:1.hebrew: במלך ומלכה - שתלויין על עבדיהן, ואין מקפידין על סעודתן, אם גדיים אם טלאים. הלכך, אין כאן דין ברירה, דתרווייהו ניחא ליה. לפיכך, יאכל מן הראשון, דכיון דליכא קפידא, יצא בראשון ידי חובתו, ואידך בכדי נשחט:
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:9:1.english: Involving a king and queen - Who rely upon their slaves and are not particular about their meal, whether [it consists of] kids or lambs. Therefore, the law of retroactive designation [bereirah] does not apply here, for both are acceptable to him. Accordingly, he should eat from the first [offering], for since there is no particularity, he fulfilled his obligation with the first, and the other was slaughtered for naught.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:9:2.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr>: והתניא, אין נמנין על שני פסחים כאחד, ומעשה במלך ומלכה כו':
Rashi on Pesachim 88b:9:2.english: This is the reading [in the text]: "And it was taught [in a baraita]: One may not register for two Paschal offerings at once, and there was an incident involving a king and queen, etc."

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:9:3.english: Two Paschal offerings - A kid and a lamb.

Rashi on Pesachim 88b:9:4.english: Go and ask the queen - She was knowledgeable and wise.

Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:15:1.hebrew: על מנת שאין לרבו רשות בו - ולמאן דאמר בפ"ק דקדושין (דף כג:) דקני רביה עד שיתן על מנת שיצא בו לחירות, ה"נ יפרש שיתן לו שיצא בו חובת פסח:
Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:15:1.english: On condition that his master has no rights to it - And according to the one who says in the first chapter of Kiddushin (23b) that his master acquires [it] unless he gives [it] on condition that he go out to freedom with it, here too he must specify that he gives [it] to him [on condition] that he fulfill the Pesach obligation with it.

Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:19:1.hebrew: קמי שמיא גליא - פירוש: ולא פסיל כל כך, הואיל ואינו בגוף הקרבן:
Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:19:1.english: It is revealed before Heaven - Explanation: And it is not disqualified so much, since it is not in the body of the offering:

Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:1:1.hebrew: לישא שפחה אינו יכול - ואם תאמר: וליתי עשה ד"פרו ורבו" (בראשית ט) וידחה לאו ד"לא יהיה קדש" (דברים כ״ג:י״ח)? וי"ל: משום דידה, דליכא עשה, דאפשר לה בעבד; ועוד, דבתחלת ביאה מיעקר לאו, ולא מיקיים עשה אלא בהוצאת זרע. וא"ת: וימכור עצמו בעבד עברי, ויהיה מותר בשפחה? וי"ל: בזמן שאין היובל נוהג, דאז נמי אינו נוהג עבד עברי. ועוד אומר ר"י, דאסור למכור עצמו בעבד עברי, כדאמרי' בפ"ק דקדושין (דף כב:). וא"ת: ישא חציה שפחה וחציה בת חורין? וי"ל: דאתי צד עבדות ומשתמש בצד חירות. ואם תאמר: וישא ממזרת? דממזר מותר בשפחה, דבפרק האומר (שם דף סט.) אמר רבי טרפון: יכולים ממזרים ליטהר, כיצד? ממזר נושא שפחה; ומותר נמי בצד חירות, דחרורי וממזירי מותרים לבא זה בזה! וי"ל: אי חציו עבד קדושין תופסין, אתי צד עבדות ומשתמש בצד אשת איש; ואי לא תפסי, אם כן בעילתו בעילת זנות — ובהשולח (גיטין מג.) מספקא ליה אי תפסי אי לא. ועוד אור"ת, דאין תקנה להרבות ממזרין. ואם תאמר: וישא נתינה? דחרורי ונתיני מותרים לבא זה בזה! וי"ל: דאף על גב דממזר מותר בשפחה, נתין אפשר דאסור בה; דקדש ועומד הוא הממזר, שנוצר מאיסור דלא תפסי קדושין, ולכך מותר בלאו ד"לא יהיה קדש". והא דאמרינן ביש מותרות (יבמות דף פה:) דממזרת ונתינה מרגלא ליה, לפי שיכול להכשיר זרעו שישא בנו שפחה — ואף על גב דנתין אסור בשפחה, האי גברא לא אכפת ליה באיסור, דהא קא נסיב נתינה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:1:1.english: He is not able to marry a maidservant - And if you ask: Let the positive commandment of "Be fruitful and multiply" (Genesis 9) come and override the negative commandment of "There shall not be a kadesh" (Deuteronomy 23:18)? One may answer: [It cannot override it] because of her side, for there is no positive commandment [of procreation incumbent upon her], since she can fulfill [any obligation] with a [fully] enslaved man. Furthermore, at the beginning of intercourse the negative commandment is uprooted, whereas the positive commandment is not fulfilled until the emission of seed. And if you ask: Let him sell himself as a Hebrew servant, and then he will be permitted [to marry] a maidservant? One may answer: [The Mishnah is speaking] of a time when the Jubilee year is not in practice, for then [the law of] a Hebrew servant is also not in practice. Furthermore, Rabbi Yitzchak says that it is forbidden to sell oneself as a Hebrew servant, as we say in the first chapter of Kiddushin (22b). And if you ask: Let him marry [a woman who is] half maidservant and half free woman? One may answer: [That is forbidden because] his slave side would come and make use of her free side. And if you ask: Let him marry a mamzeret? For a mamzer is permitted to [marry] a maidservant, as in the chapter HaOmer (ibid., 69a) Rabbi Tarfon said: Mamzerim can be purified; how so? A mamzer marries a maidservant! And he is also permitted [to marry her] on account of his free side, since freed slaves and mamzerim are permitted to marry one another! One may answer: If betrothal takes effect [for] one who is half slave, his slave side would come and make use of the side [of her that is] a married woman; and if [betrothal] does not take effect, if so, his intercourse is licentious intercourse — and in [the chapter] HaSholeach (Gittin 43a), [the Gemara] is uncertain whether [betrothal] takes effect or not. Furthermore, Rabbeinu Tam says that it is not a [proper] remedy to increase mamzerim. And if you ask: Let him marry a netinah? For freed slaves and netinim are permitted to marry one another! One may answer: Even though a mamzer is permitted to [marry] a maidservant, it is possible that a natin is forbidden to her; for a mamzer already stands in a state of kadesh, since he was conceived from a forbidden union where betrothal does not take effect, and therefore he is permitted [despite] the negative commandment of "There shall not be a kadesh." And as for what we say in [the chapter] Yesh Mutarot (Yevamot 85b), that a mamzeret and a netinah are advantageous for him because he can legitimize his offspring by having his son marry a maidservant — even though a natin is forbidden to a maidservant, this man does not care about the prohibition, since he himself is marrying a netinah.

Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:1:2.hebrew: כופין את רבו - בחציה שפחה אין כופין את רבה אלא היכא דנהגו בה מנהג הפקר; היינו משום דכשישחררה שמא לא תקיים, כיון דלא מיחייבה. וא"ת: אמאי כופין? וכי אומר לו לאדם חטא בשביל שיזכה חבירו, דהמשחרר עבדו עובר בעשה? וי"ל: מצוה רבה שאני, ד"לא תהו בראה לשבת יצרה", כדמשני (ברכות דף מז:) גבי ר"א ששיחרר עבדו — מצוה דרבים שאני:
Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:1:2.english: We force his master - In [the case of a woman who is] half-maidservant, we do not force her master [to free her] except where [people] treat her in a licentious manner; this is because when he frees her, perhaps she will not fulfill [the mitzvah of procreation], since she is not obligated [in it]. And if you say: Why do we force [him]? Do we say to a person, "Sin so that your fellow may merit," since one who frees his slave transgresses a positive commandment? And one can say [in resolution]: A great mitzvah is different, as [it is written,] "He did not create it to be a waste; He formed it to be inhabited," just as [the Gemara] answers (Berakhot 47b) regarding Rabbi Eliezer, who freed his slave — a mitzvah of the many is different.

Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:7:1.hebrew: והתניא אין נמנין על שני פסחים כאחד - פירש בקונטרס דברייתא סברה דאין ברירה, ולא מצי לשנויי דמתניתין קסבר דיש ברירה, דאם כן הוה ליה למיתני "מאיזה שירצה יאכל". וא"ת: ואמאי לא משני דברייתא קתני כשנמנה על ב' פסחים כא', והתם ודאי לא יאכל משניהם, אבל מתניתין כשהמנוהו זה אחר זה, דדעתו על הראשון? וי"ל דמתני' קאמר ראשון לשחיטה, אע"פ שהמנה עליו לבסוף:
Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:7:1.english: And wasn't it taught: One may not be registered for two Paschal offerings at once - Rashi explained that the baraita holds that there is no retroactive designation [bereirah], and [the Gemara] could not answer that our Mishnah holds that there is retroactive designation, because if so, [the Mishnah] should have taught: "From whichever one he wants, he may eat." And if you ask: Why does [the Gemara] not answer that the baraita teaches [a case] where he was registered for two Paschal offerings simultaneously, and there he certainly may not eat from both of them, whereas our Mishnah [deals with a case] where they registered him one after the other, so that his intention is for the first one? And one can answer that our Mishnah is speaking of [the] first to be slaughtered, even though he was registered for it last.

Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:8:1.hebrew: במלך ומלכה - שיש להם רוב מעדנים, ולא קפדי אם גדי ואם טלה, אם שמן אם כחוש:
Tosafot on Pesachim 88b:8:1.english: Of a king and queen - Who have an abundance of delicacies, and are not particular whether [it is] a kid or a lamb, [or] whether [it is] fat or lean.
